records.verificationNote: Tier and quantity-limit flags for the risperidone microspheres read by x-coordinate on page 38 (Tier 4, QL 2 per 28 days; no PA on any long-acting injectable on pages 35-38). Judgment: all long-acting options are Tier 4 with no PA, so the preferred pick is Risperdal Consta, a common product whose QL matches its every-2-week label dosing. Long-acting injectables are usually given in a clinic and may fall under the Part B medical benefit rather than Part D; the guide prints no BvsD flag on these rows, so the cost path is unconfirmed. Perseris, Uzedy and Rykindo do not appear in the guide. The guide does not state it is complete, so they are not recorded as excluded. [Sonnet check 2026-10-27: Re-confirmed against Humana formulary 26402, v17 (updated 10/01/2026), sources/humana-premier-rx-pdp-newtopics-2026-10.pdf (tier, PA, ST, QL read by x-coordinate; the v16 copy used in the first pass is superseded). Risperdal Consta is Tier 4, QL 2 per 28 days, no PA on page 38. Sustenna is on pages 36-37, Trinza on 37, Hafyera on 36. Stays partial: no BvsD flag is printed, so the Part B or Part D path for clinic-given injections is unconfirmed.] [Reused: same national Humana Premier Rx PDP formulary (exported 2026-11-02)]
